name: Chained in Backrooms
desc:
Chained in the Backrooms is a player co-op, mission-based obby horror game that you can play up to 8 players!

🤝 Work together to survive the horrors, solve puzzles, complete challenging missions, and survive against creatures trying to destroy them all while chained together!

👍 LIKE + FAVORITE to show your support!

🎁 FREE IN-GAME REWARD:
• Join group Musta and Alexander
• LIKE & FAVORITE the game

Heavily Inspired by "Chained in the Backrooms."
